name: Account main login
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Account main login.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Legacy customer account template. Shopify owns account authentication, email delivery and session rules. Current customer accounts operate outside the theme; this section does not migrate accounts or add social login.

settings.label: Layout style
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout style. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.
